notes.title: Now also available for Mac!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42163198/b07576c107d31d166118c2d7b99e0416e442bca3.jpg

Now on Mac!

Yes, Robotherapy is also now available for the machines called Macintosh! Are they still called that? What a strange name!

It's also on sale! A whole 50% off!

(wait, that's not whole, that's literally half!)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895970/Robotherapy/

Also check out my new narrative game, Firelore: Short Tales — also available on Mac!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3289270/Firelore_Short_Tales/
